job.job_description:
Job Summary

Seeking a highly skilled GenAI Engineer with expertise in designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions, LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, and conversational AI platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, FastAPI, Python, and cloud technologies.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and deploy Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions.
Build enterprise chatbots and AI assistants using LLMs and conversational AI platforms.
Design scalable APIs and AI microservices using Python and FastAPI.
Implement vector search solutions using ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone, and Neo4j.
Integrate AI applications with AWS, OpenAI, Vertex AI, and Hugging Face.
Ensure security, PII compliance, monitoring, and performance optimization.



Required Skills

Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
AI/ML: OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, Multi-Agent Systems, MCP, Vertex AI
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, ChromaDB, FAISS, Neo4j
Frameworks: FastAPI, Node.js, React.js
Cloud & Tools: AWS, Docker, Git, RabbitMQ, SonarQube, JMeter



Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech in Computer Science or related field.
Experience building AI solutions for large enterprises.
Strong understanding of enterprise chatbot platforms, cloud-native development, and AI governance.
